title: 第十七章 笑面虎请茶第十八章 风雨欲来
content_zh:
蝎子在第五天夜里带来了何成局要的消息。
“城东那座私宅，查清楚了。”他把一张皱巴巴的纸摊在枇杷树下的石桌上，用手指点着上面歪歪扭扭的炭笔标记，“宅子的主人姓唐，叫唐文敬，是个告老还乡的户部主事，前年死的。宅子现在住的是他的遗孀和一个小丫鬟。表面上是正经人家，但雷虎每两天去一次，每次都从后门进，进去之后院子里的灯就灭了，也不见人出来走动。我在对面屋顶蹲了两宿，发现那个遗孀跟雷虎说话的时候低着头弯着腰——不是小妾对老爷的姿态，是下属对上司的姿态。”
“那宅子是斧头帮的暗点。”何成局说。
“不止是暗点。”蝎子的声音压得更低了，“我在屋顶上看到后院里堆着十几口大木箱，用油布盖着。其中一口箱子油布没盖严实，月光底下能看见里面装的是铁器——刀、斧头、箭头，全是开了刃的。”
何成局的手指在石桌上轻轻敲了敲。私藏兵器。斧头帮在城里囤积兵器，这件事本身不稀奇，稀奇的是他们选择藏在城东一座看似普通的民宅里，而不是藏在总舵或者城外。这说明雷虎在防着谁——不是怕官府，而是怕其他帮派。广州城里能跟斧头帮抗衡的势力不多，铁线帮和洪门都有可能。但更让何成局在意的不是这个。
“雷虎每次去那座宅子，带几个人？”
“两个亲随。一个叫张铁柱，斧头帮总舵的护卫头领，武者三阶。另一个叫钱七，账房，凡人。”蝎子说到这里，顿了一下，抬头看着何成局，“石破军不去。”
何成局的手指停了。
“你确定？”
“确定。石破军住在斧头帮总舵后院的客房里，每天除了吃饭不出门。我让范老六的一个徒弟扮成卖鱼的，在总舵后门的巷子里蹲了三天，只看到石破军出来过一次——去了一趟铁线帮的地盘，不知道谈了什么，半个时辰就回去了。他从来没跟雷虎一起去过城东私宅。”
何成局靠在枇杷树的树干上，仰头看着树冠里若隐若现的青果。月光透过叶隙洒在他脸上，斑驳的光影让人看不清他此刻的表情。
石破军不去私宅。这是一个比任何情报都重要的信息。雷虎是斧头帮帮主，武者六阶，手底下几百号人，在广州城的地下势力中排得进前三。他行事谨慎，几乎从不落单。只有在去城东私宅的时候，他的防备才会降到最低——因为他不想让太多人知道私宅的存在。那两个亲随就是他在那个地点仅有的护卫。
一个武者六阶的炼体巅峰高手，带着一个武者三阶的护卫和一个凡人账房。这样的配置在雷虎看来足够安全——因为他的对手最多也就是武者三四阶的水平，别说杀他，连近他的身都做不到。
但何成局从来不是靠正面硬刚来解决问题的人。
他收回目光，从石桌上拿起那张纸，对着月光重新看了一遍。唐文敬的遗孀，小丫鬟，钱七，张铁柱，雷虎。一宅五个人。雷虎每两天去一次，申时到，待一个时辰左右，酉时离开。
“今天几号？”
“三月十八。”蝎子说。
“上一次雷虎去私宅是什么时候？”
“三月十七。昨天下午。”
何成局在心里默算了一下。三月十七去了，隔两天就是三月十九。明天。

“蝎子，明天下午我要用一个人。不是范老六的徒弟，是另一个——水性好，胆子大，但不需要会功夫。跑得快就行。”
蝎子想了一下：“码头上有一种人，叫‘跑水签’。专门帮人递送私货清单的，官府抓得严，他们跑得快，胆子也大，被抓了也不会供出雇主。一个晚上二两银子就能雇到。”
“信得过？”
“跑水签吃的是信誉饭。一旦供出雇主，以后就没人敢用他了。所以宁肯挨板子也不会开口。”
“行。明天午时之前，让他到观音巷来见我。”
蝎子点了点头，没有问何成局打算做什么。他从石桌上拿起何成局给他倒的那碗茶一饮而尽，然后用袖子抹了抹嘴，站起来推门走了。
何成局在枇杷树下又坐了很久。他把闭气散的小瓷瓶从怀里摸出来，放在石桌上，对着月光看了看。瓷瓶在月光下泛着幽幽的青光，拇指大的一小瓶，却装着足够让一个武者七阶高手暂时失去内劲的猛药。
何成局对自己说：明天申时，雷虎去私宅，带两个随从。自己在雷虎进门之前潜入私宅，把闭气散下在茶水里。雷虎进门之后一定会喝茶——这是广州商人和帮派头目谈事的习惯，边喝茶边说事。茶碗端起来，喝一口，闭气散入体，内劲被封。然后自己从藏身处出来，把雷虎带到内室，关上门，慢慢谈。
一盏茶的时间。够用。
前提是闭气散真的能封住武者六阶的内劲。前提是雷虎真的会喝茶。前提是张铁柱不会在他动手之前发现他。前提是石破军不会突然出现在私宅。前提很多，每一个前提出错都会让他死得很难看。
但等了这么多天，何成局已经不想再等了。再等下去，林则徐查抄鸦片的时候潘启明把他供出来，或者石破军哪天心血来潮决定去观音巷搜查，或者雷虎找到霍天德的铁器作坊把那批货翻出来——这三种情况随便发生哪一种，他的处境都会比现在更糟。
他拿起闭气散，站起来，走进了屋里。
三月十九，申时。
广州城的午后阳光已经带上了一丝初夏的燥热。柳花巷两边的柳树被晒得叶子打卷，卖凉茶的小贩在巷口吆喝，声音有气无力。城东这一片却安静得多——这里的宅子都是官宦人家的私邸，院墙高，门脸深，街上几乎看不到行人。
唐文敬的宅子在城东最深的一条巷子里，门面不大，黑漆大门，门楣上挂着两个褪了色的红灯笼，看起来跟普通的民居没什么区别。唯一不同的是这条巷子是个死胡同，三面都是高墙，只有一条路进出。对于隐秘会面来说这是个好地方——只要派人守住巷口，任何人都进不来。但对于要潜入的人来说，这意味着一旦被发现，退路就只剩下翻墙。
何成局已经在对面宅子的屋脊上趴了半个时辰。
他穿了一身瓦灰色的短打，脸上蒙了同色的面巾，整个人伏在瓦片上，和屋顶的颜色融为一体。笑面虎短刀插在背后，刀柄用黑布缠了，不会反光。怀里揣着闭气散的小瓷瓶，已经被他的体温捂得微微发热。
申时一刻，巷口走进来三个人。
雷虎走在最前面。他今天穿的是便装——灰色绸衫，黑色马褂，手里拿着一把折扇，看起来像个出门访友的富商。但何成局隔着老远就能感觉到这个人身上那种若有若无的压迫感。武者六阶的气血充盈到了极致，走路的时候每一步都踏得很实，青石板被他的千层底布鞋踩过之后不留声响，但脚底的石缝里震出了细细的尘土。
content_en:
Scorpion brought the important news to He Chengju on the night of the fifth day.
"The private house in the east of the city has been thoroughly investigated." He spread out a crumpled piece of paper on the stone table under the loquat tree and pointed at the crooked charcoal marks on it with his finger. "The owner of the house is named Tang Wenjing. He was the head of the household department who retired and returned to his hometown. He died the year before last. His widow and a young maid are currently living in the house. On the surface. It was a decent house, but Lei Hu went there every two days, and every time he entered through the back door. After entering, the lights in the courtyard were turned off, and no one came out to move around. I squatted on the roof opposite for two nights, and found that the widow lowered her head and bent her waist when talking to Lei Hu - not the attitude of a concubine to the master, but the attitude of a subordinate to a boss. "
"That house is the dark spot of the Ax Gang." He Chengju said.
"It's not just dark spots." Scorpion's voice became even lower. "I was on the roof and saw a dozen large wooden boxes stacked in the backyard, covered with oilcloth. One of the boxes was not covered tightly with oilcloth. Under the moonlight, you could see that it contained iron tools - knives, axes, arrowheads, all edged."
He Chengju tapped his fingers lightly on the stone table. Hidden weapons. The Ax Gang was hoarding weapons in the city, which was not unusual in itself. What was strange was that they chose to hide in a seemingly ordinary house in the east of the city instead of hiding in the main helm or outside the city. This shows who Lei Hu is guarding against - not the government, but other gangs. There are not many forces in Guangzhou that can compete with the Ax Gang, including the Iron Wire Gang and the Hongmen. But what worries He Chengju more is not this.
"Every time Lei Hu goes to that house, how many people does he take with him?"
"Two personal followers. One is called Zhang Tiezhu, the guard leader of the Ax Gang, a third-level warrior. The other is called Qian Qi, accountant, a mortal." After Xiezi said this, he paused and looked up at He Chengju, "Shi Pojun is not going."
He Chengju's fingers stopped.
"Are you sure?"
"Confirmed. Shi Pojun lives in the guest room in the backyard of the Ax Gang's chief helmsman and doesn't go out except for eating every day. I asked one of Fan Laoliu's apprentices to dress up as a fish seller and squat in the alley at the back door of the chief helmsman for three days. I only saw Shi Pojun come out once - he went to the Iron Wire Gang's territory. I don't know what we talked about, but he went back in half an hour. He has never been to the private house in the east of the city with Lei Hu."
He Chengju leaned against the trunk of the loquat tree, looking up at the looming green fruits in the crown. The moonlight shines on his face through the gaps in the leaves, and the mottled light and shadow make it difficult to see his expression at the moment.
Shi Pojun did not go to the private house. This is more important information than any intelligence. Lei Hu is the leader of the Ax Gang. He is a sixth-level warrior and has hundreds of people under his command. He is ranked among the top three underground forces in Guangzhou City. He was cautious and almost never left alone. Only when he goes to a private house in the east of the city, his defenses will be minimized - because he doesn't want too many people to know about the existence of the private house. Those two personal followers were his only guards at that location.
A peak body-refining master of the sixth level of martial arts, accompanied by a bodyguard of a third-level warrior and a mortal accountant. This configuration is safe enough in Lei Hu's opinion - because his opponent is at most a third- or fourth-level warrior, and he cannot even get close to him, let alone kill him.
But He Chengju has never been one to solve problems head-on.
He withdrew his gaze, picked up the piece of paper from the stone table, and read it again in the moonlight. Tang Wenjing's widow, little maid, Qian Qi, Zhang Tiezhu, Lei Hu. Five people in one house. Lei Hu goes there every two days, arriving at Shen time, staying for about an hour, and leaving at You time.
"What's today's date?"
"March 18." Scorpion said.
"When was the last time Lei Hu went to a private house?"
"March 17. Yesterday afternoon."
He Chengju made some calculations in his mind. March 17th has passed, and it will be March 19th two days later. tomorrow.
"Scorpion, I'm going to use someone tomorrow afternoon. It's not Fan Laoliu's apprentice, it's another—- Good water quality and courage, but no kung fu is required. Just run fast. "
Scorpion thought for a moment: "There is a kind of person on the dock called a 'water signer'. Those who specialize in delivering lists of private goods are severely punished by the government. They are fast and courageous, and will not reveal their employer if caught. You can hire him for two taels of silver a night. "
"Can you trust it? "
“If you run a water visa, you will get a reputation. Once he betrays his employer, no one will dare to use him in the future. So I would rather get slapped than open my mouth. "
"OK. Let him come to see me at Guanyin Lane before noon tomorrow. "
Scorpion nodded and did not ask what He Chengju planned to do. He picked up the bowl of tea that He Chengju poured for him from the stone table and drank it in one gulp, then wiped his mouth with his sleeve, stood up, opened the door and left.
He Chengju sat under the loquat tree for a long time. He took out the small porcelain bottle of breath-holding powder from his arms, placed it on the stone table, and looked at the moonlight. The porcelain bottle glowed with a faint green light under the moonlight. It was a small bottle as big as a thumb, but it contained enough powerful medicine to make a seventh-level warrior master temporarily lose his inner strength.
He Chengju said to himself: At the time of application tomorrow, Lei Hu will go to his private house and take two followers with him. Before Lei Hu came in, he sneaked into the private house and dispersed his breath into the tea. Lei Hu will definitely drink tea after entering the house - this is the habit of Guangzhou businessmen and gang leaders talking about things while drinking tea. Pick up the tea bowl, take a sip, hold your breath and disperse it into your body, sealing your inner energy. Then he came out of the hiding place, took Lei Hu to the inner room, closed the door, and talked slowly.
Time for a cup of tea. Enough.
The premise is that the breath-holding powder can really seal the warrior's sixth level internal energy. The premise is that Lei Hu really knows how to drink tea. The premise is that Zhang Tiezhu will not discover him before he takes action. The premise is that Shi Pojun will not suddenly appear in the private house. There are many premises, and if every premise goes wrong, he will die an ugly death.
But after waiting for so many days, He Chengju didn't want to wait any longer. If he waits any longer, Pan Qiming will turn him in when Lin Zexu confiscated opium, or Shi Pojun will decide on a whim to search Guanyin Alley, or Lei Hu will find Huo Tiande's ironworks workshop and dig out the goods - any one of these three situations will happen, and his situation will be worse than now.
He picked up the breath-holding powder, stood up, and walked into the house.
March 19th, Shen Shi.
The afternoon sunshine in Guangzhou City has brought with it a touch of early summer heat. The leaves of the willow trees on both sides of Liuhua Lane were curled up in the sun. The vendors selling herbal tea shouted weakly at the entrance of the lane. The area to the east of the city is much quieter - the houses here are all private residences of officials, with high courtyard walls and deep fronts, and almost no pedestrians can be seen on the street.
Tang Wenjing's house is located in the deepest alley in the east of the city. It has a small facade, a black door, and two faded red lanterns hanging on the lintel. It looks no different from an ordinary house. The only difference is that this alley is a dead end, with high walls on three sides and only one way in and out. It's a good place for a secret meeting - as long as someone guards the alley, no one can get in. But for those who want to infiltrate, this means that once discovered, the only way out is to climb over the wall.
He Chengju has been lying on the roof of the house opposite for half an hour.
He was wearing a tile-grey shorts, and his face was covered with a scarf of the same color. He was lying on the tiles, blending in with the color of the roof. The Smiling Tiger dagger was stuck behind his back, and the handle was wrapped in black cloth so it wouldn't reflect light. In his arms was a small porcelain bottle of breath-holding powder, which was already slightly warmed by his body temperature.
At the last moment, three people walked in from the alley.
Lei Hu walked in the front. He was wearing casual clothes today - a gray silk shirt, a black mandarin jacket, and holding a folding fan in his hand. He looked like a wealthy businessman going out to visit friends. But He Chengju could feel the vague sense of oppression on this person from a long distance away. The Qi and blood of the sixth-level warrior are filled to the extreme. Every step he takes when walking is very solid. The bluestone is covered by his thousand-layer cloth shoes.There was no sound after stepping on it, but fine dust shook out from the stone crevices under the feet.
